# gauzzaDocs plugin marketplace

<!-- Generated by `npm run marketplace` from plugins/*/plugin.json and plugins/external.json. Do not edit by hand. -->

13 plugins. Install them in the app under **Plugins → Marketplace…**, or from a terminal with
`gdocs plugins install <id>`. Every file is checked against the SHA-256 recorded in [marketplace.json](marketplace.json).

Want to add one? See [how to submit a plugin](README.md#submitting-a-plugin) or [open a submission](https://github.com/mattgauzza/gauzzaDocs/issues/new?template=plugin-submission.yml).

## Data

| | Plugin | Version | What it does | Works with |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 📊 | [**CSV table preview**](csv-preview/) `csv-preview` | 1.0.0 | See CSV/TSV text as a table, and align columns in plain-text CSV. | csv |
| 📋 | [**Markdown tables**](markdown-tables/) `markdown-tables` | 1.0.0 | Turn CSV/TSV (or a copied spreadsheet range) into a Markdown table and back, and tidy every table in a file. | markdown, csv, text |
| 🔁 | [**JSON ↔ YAML**](yaml-tools/) `yaml-tools` | 1.0.0 | Convert JSON to YAML and YAML to JSON (block-style YAML: maps, lists, scalars, comments), and normalise YAML indentation. | json, yaml |
